title: Read task-sync commit deltas through the existing hardened Git intake
outcome: Return changed task documents and explicit deletions between retained source commits without reading unchanged task blobs.
acceptance: Given explicit prior and incoming commits, derive NUL-delimited changes for .engram through the existing Git executor, covering the complete old-to-new tree delta including intervening and merge commits.
Read and decode only added or modified task blobs plus project.json; represent deletion without reading a removed blob and handle renames as removal plus addition.
Reject missing bases, invalid paths or modes, links, malformed changed documents and wrong project bindings by name; preserve all input and make no importer, ref or durable-store mutation.

Tests count task blob reads on at least 2,000 tasks with five modifications, one addition and one deletion, prove unchanged blobs stay unread, and cover no-op, rename, missing-base and malformed-input cases.

completion.summary: Land task-sync commit delta intake in combined task-sync candidate
